name: Life-as explainer
beats: Hook: the surprising answer in the first 20 s
A normal day, hour by hour
What modern viewers can take from it
hook: Open on the answer that breaks the viewer's picture of the past.
title_pattern: What Did [People] Actually Do [All Day / situation]?
thumbnail_pattern: A daylight scene with 1-3 words of the answer in yellow capitals. Don't repeat the title.
evidence: History videos of 15-30 min had a median of 246k views, and 65% of those channels passed 100k. 'What Did Cavemen Actually Do All Day?' got 1.5M, 429 times the channel's usual.

name: Pain-word silent film
beats: Cold open on the pain (no words)
The turn: someone from another time does it differently
hook: One searched pain word on screen, the character living it.
thumbnail_pattern: Dark face close-up + the character's own line in 1-3 words
evidence: Not tested in the scan, since no silent story channel was in it. Pick a pain people already search for (discipline, dopamine, lazy, phone). Mood words flop.

name: Then vs Now split Short
beats: Small labels, music and sound effects, no voice
hook: First split lands in under 1 s.
evidence: Animated split montages of 31-38 s did well. The ones of 10-22 s flopped.

name: Money-disaster story
beats: The outcome or twist in the first 20 s
hook: Lead with the dollar amount when the number is the shock.
title_pattern: The [Scam] That Broke [Institution] / How [Group] Lost $[Huge] on [Thing]
evidence: Drawn money-story channels had medians of 1.85M (24 min films), 942k (21 min) and 653k (10 min). Generic finance channels got 20k.

name: Every [X] Explained ladder
beats: Promise the full set and the time
The last level is the payoff
hook: The time in the title does the work.
title_pattern: Every [X] Explained in [N] Minutes / Every Level of [X]
thumbnail_pattern: Ladder or grid of the set, 1-3 words
evidence: 1.8 times more common among breakout videos than among all the videos scanned. 'Every Level of Wealth in 13 Minutes' got 4.8M views and 'EVERY Crusader Military Order Explained' 1.8M.

name: [Hard thing] Is Easy, Actually
beats: The one idea that makes it easy
Show it working in 3 small steps
hook: Name the hard thing and promise it flips.
thumbnail_pattern: Character relaxed next to the 'hard' thing, 1-2 words
evidence: 2.76 times more common among breakout videos than among all the videos scanned. 'Being Confident Is Easy, Actually' got 647k views, 199 times the channel's usual.

name: Story of [X] | Animated Movie
beats: Known story, told start to end
Three acts with a midpoint turn
hook: A famous story people already search for.
evidence: 2.37 times more common among breakout videos than among all the videos scanned. 'David and Goliath | Animated Bible Movie' got 8.2M views and 'Story of Daniel | Full Animated Bible Movie' 634k.

name: Start-to-Finish build
hook: Show the finished result for 2 s, then cut to the empty start.
thumbnail_pattern: Finished build, warm light, no text or 1 word
evidence: 'Man Builds Amazing Wooden Mansion... Start to Finish' got 1.4M views, 74 times the channel's usual. Build videos get millions of views without any words.

name: You Wouldn't Survive [time] in [era]
beats: Drop the viewer in, second person
The thing that kills modern people first
evidence: 1.74 times more common among breakout videos than among all the videos scanned. 'Why You Wouldn't Survive 24 Hours in Stone Age' got 357k views, 102 times the channel's usual.
